values.meaning: bonus magic damage on the enchanted attack/ability hit, based on enchanted ally's AD
values.quote: {{as|{{pp|7;11;15|1;6;9|key=%}} of enchanted target's AD}} {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}}

values.meaning: total burn damage over 1.5s, split into ticks
values.binNote: BurnDamage's flat part is an unresolved constant {ee18a47b} in the sheet; the wiki's 10-to-50 by-level values (BaseDamageStart/BaseDamageEnd) are assumed to be that interpolated constant, and the 0.2xap ratio matches the wiki's 20% AP.

values.meaning: duration over which the burn tick damage is dealt

values.binNote: No explicit tick-interval data value on the sheet; derived from the wiki's per-tick formula footnote which divides the total by intervals of 0.25s.

values.meaning: duration of the Fired Up! enchantment before it expires unused
values.binNote: No matching data value found on the passive's sheet entry for the 4-second enchantment window.

mechanics.claim: The enchantment triggers on the next basic attack or ability hit against an enemy after being granted, dealing the burst damage immediately followed by the burn DoT.
mechanics.quote: causes the next {{tip|basic attack}}<!--not on-hit--> or ability hit against enemies to deal {{as|{{pp|7;11;15|1;6;9|key=%}} of enchanted target's AD}} {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} and apply a burn

mechanics.claim: Reapplying the enchantment before it triggers only refreshes its duration, it does not stack multiple triggers.
mechanics.quote: Subsequent applications of ''Fired Up!'' only refresh the duration.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield cannot block the effect when it is delivered by a basic attack.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will not block the effect if applied by a basic attack.

mechanics.claim: When triggered by an ally's hit, the damage is tagged as proc damage.
mechanics.quote: When the damage is triggered by allies, it is additionally tagged as {{tip|proc damage}}.
